jobs.description:
Om skolan

Internationella Engelska Skolan Liljeholmen är en grundskola med årskurs F-9 som ligger vid Midsommarkransen, nära både tunnelbana och buss. Skolan startades 2014 och har idag över 120 anställda och ca 1200 elever. Om du vill arbeta i en internationell miljö med en stödjande kultur är IES Liljeholmen platsen för dig. Vi har en bred elevgrupp som talar omkring ett 50-tal olika modersmål samt en personalgrupp som är internationellt rik. Vi vill uppmuntra och stödja internationellt utbildade lärare som börjar hos oss på IES Liljeholmen att både lära sig svenska samt komplettera sin lärarutbildning för att nå en svensk lärarlegitimation på sikt.

Om tjänsten

Internationella Engelska Skolan Liljeholmen söker för närvarande en behörig lärare i svenska som andraspråk i årskurs 4-5 under vårterminen 2027. Du kommer att ingå i arbetslaget för år 4 och dela mentorsansvar för en klass samt undervisa svenska som andraspråk för årskurs 4-5. Tjänsten är ett visstidskontrakt.

Din profil

Du är en kvalificerad lärare för de angivna ämnet och åldersgrupperna. Vi hoppas att du inser vikten av att bygga och upprätthålla goda relationer med kollegor, elever och föräldrar. Du är motiverad att ha regelbunden kontakt med föräldrar, leda mentorstimmar enligt mentorprogrammet och arbeta tillsammans i en stödjande miljö. Det finns inget krav på tidigare lärarerfarenhet, men vi värdesätter ditt självförtroende i ditt professionella ledarskap och din förmåga att skapa en trygg och stabil miljö både i och utanför klassrummet. Du värderar och levererar personligt, tydligt och balanserat ledarskap med fokus på både struktur och elevengagemang. Som lärare är du en tydlig och aktiv förebild.

Anställningsprocess

Vi kommer att hålla löpande intervjuer för tjänsten, så vi rekommenderar att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Om du tror att detta kan vara rätt tjänst för dig, tveka inte att ansöka! Vi ser fram emot att ta del av din ansökan och få möjlighet att diskutera tjänsten och dina kvalifikationer närmare.

Övrig information

Alla Internationella Engelska skolor runt om i landet delar samma vision för utbildning, kallad IES Ethos. Läs gärna mer om detta för att se om det överensstämmer med dina egna professionella värderingar och övertygelser. På IES erbjuds alla anställda en pedagogisk lunch. IES följer Almega kollektivavtal för fristående skolor.

Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner. Hos oss får lärare fokus på undervisning och lärande. Eleverna står i centrum för allt vi gör, alla elever är dina elever.

På Internationella engelska skolan är vi ett team som drar åt samma håll. För att tycka om att jobba hos oss bör du dela vår övertygelse om vikten av tydliga värderingar, kollegialt lärande och gemensamma rutiner och förhållningssätt.

About Spiideo 
Spiideo is a fast growing sports technology company headquartered in Malmö. We provide software services to the world of sports in the areas of performance analysis and automated video production of games and practice in stadiums, arenas and training facilities.
Our camera systems combine hardware, AI and cloud technology to automate sports video production and analysis. Over the last few years Spiideo has grown quickly and we are now shipping thousands of cameras all over the world!

A key piece of our product line is our portfolio of network-connected camera systems to do the video capture. We run an in-house Camera System Production & Distribution Unit in Malmö, where we assemble and ship the camera systems that power Spiideo's platform for customers all over the world. As a Camera Assembly Assistant, you'll play a key role in ensuring our camera systems are assembled, tested and shipped with the quality our customers expect.
You will be working in a modern, office-like environment with light mechanical assembly in our production team. The job tasks will also include receiving and packing material deliveries.

Valid Swedish Driver's License

Production/Assembly Experience: prior work in a production or manufacturing setting with high quality standards.

Mechanical hands-on ability: basic skills with light mechanical assembly or similar "handy" tasks.

Physical capability: to receive and lift heavy deliveries in our warehouse

Experienced and comfortable working in a digital and computer-based environment.

Efficient and quick learner: ability to take directions, rapidly absorb instructions, and work effectively in environments with repetitive tasks.

Attention to Detail: critical for ensuring quality during assembly and accurate handling of deliveries.

Organized with a positive attitude: ability to plan and coordinate tasks effectively within the team.

English communication skills: strong verbal and written English communication skills as we are an international organization. 

Fork lift licence is a merit but not mandatory.

Position details 
This position is a full-time position, placed at our recently established Camera System Production & Distribution Unit in Limhamn, Malmö. Normal working hours are Monday-Friday 08:30 - 16:30. 
This position requires that you already hold a permanent right to work in Sweden (e.g. EU/EEA citizenship, permanent residence, or a permanent work permit). We are unfortunately not able to sponsor work permits for this role
What we offer

A role in a fast-growing sports tech company with a global footprint

Build and ship products used by some of the world's leading sports organizations, leagues and teams

See the impact of your work: every camera you assemble helps coaches, players, broadcasters and officials around the world to capture, analyze and share sports

jobs.occupation: We are looking for welders for our workshop in Kalix
jobs.description:
At Nova Industri, we are committed to shaping the green industry of the future. We are proud to contribute to the development of the region and to creating a brighter, greener future.
About Nova Industri
Nova Industri AB is now part of SMS group Nordic, with SMS group GmbH in Germany as our parent company. We are a leading service company specialising in industrial production and mechanical engineering, with operations in Boden and Kalix.
For more than 20 years, we have delivered high-quality solutions in turning, milling, welding and steel construction. Our customers are primarily industrial companies in Norrbotten, and our strong local presence is an important part of our success.
About the role
As a manual welder with us, you will be responsible for carrying out qualified welding work on various materials and in different dimensions. You will work daytime shifts, both in the workshop and out in the field.
This is an independent role, making it important that you can read and work from technical drawings, welding procedure specifications (WPS) and work instructions. You will also be responsible for ensuring that the work is carried out in accordance with applicable quality requirements.
Your main responsibilities will include:
Manual welding using the MMA (111), MAG (135, 136, 138) and TIG (141) processes.
Interpreting technical drawings, welding procedures and work instructions.
Performing welding work in various positions, such as PA, PB and PF.
Carrying out visual self-inspections of completed welds.
Contributing to a safe and clean working environment.

We believe that you have
A vocational upper-secondary education in welding or equivalent qualifications.
At least two years of documented experience in manual welding in an industrial environment.
As our working environment is international, it is an advantage if you understand and can communicate in English.
An understanding of and experience in applying occupational health and safety regulations, as well as experience working with personal protective equipment.

It is an advantage if you have
A valid welding certificate in accordance with SS-EN ISO 9606-1 for steel, or another relevant standard depending on the material.
Experience in stainless steel and aluminium welding.
Hot Work certification.
SSG Lift and Fall Protection training.
A valid driving licence and an overhead crane licence.

As a person, you are
Meticulous, with a strong focus on safety and quality.
Self-motivated, able to take initiative and solve problems that arise in your work.
Cooperative and flexible in your approach.

Submit your application today. Interviews will be conducted continuously.
We look forward to receiving your application in English. If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact our HR Manager, Maria Taylor, at maria.taylor@sms-group.com.
We look forward to hearing from you.

P.S
We will participate on the European Job Days event the 6th of November Swedish Day – Cross-border Sweden / Norway | EURES - European Job Days We hope to meet you there!

jobs.occupation: PhD in Boreal Raptor Ecology under Climate Change
jobs.description:
Department of Wildlife, Fish, and Environmental Studies
Research subject:
Biology
Description of the doctoral project
Boreal Raptors – Understanding and Predicting the Dynamics of Mountain Raptor Communities under Climate Change
Why do some raptor species thrive while others decline as northern ecosystems become warmer? We are seeking a motivated PhD student to join the Boreal Raptor Project to investigate how climate, prey dynamics, landscape changes and interactions among species shape raptor communities in mountain and boreal forest ecosystems.
The project combines long-term monitoring data from northern Sweden and the Scandinavian mountains with new field observations and quantitative ecological modelling. We will examine variation in species occurrence, breeding phenology, reproductive success and distribution, and investigate how these patterns can be used to predict changes under future climate and land-use scenarios.
The research may include eagles, falcons, hawks and other raptors characteristic of northern ecosystems, as well as ecological interactions with species such as ravens.
Key questions include how weather, snow conditions and prey populations influence different raptor species, why species differ in their responses, and how forestry, infrastructure and other landscape changes interact with climate-driven processes. Specific research questions will be developed jointly with the PhD student.
About the position
Research tasks
The PhD student will analyse existing long-term datasets and newly collected information on species occurrence, breeding territories, reproductive success and environmental conditions.
The research will involve advanced statistical and spatial modelling, potentially including generalised linear mixed models, hierarchical models, occupancy and population models, time-series analysis and community ecology approaches. GIS and remote sensing will be used to quantify changes in climate, snow cover, vegetation and land use.
Fieldwork in mountain and boreal forest environments may include breeding territory surveys, reproductive monitoring and collection of complementary ecological data.
An important objective is to move beyond describing historical patterns towards developing models capable of predicting future ecological changes.
Requirements
Eligibility
Applicants must hold a second-cycle (Master's) degree, have completed at least 240 higher education credits, including 60 credits at second-cycle level, or have acquired substantially equivalent knowledge through other means in Sweden or abroad (Swedish Higher Education Ordinance, Chapter 7, Section 39).
English proficiency equivalent to English B/6 in the Swedish upper-secondary school system is required.
Your profile
We seek candidates with a Master's degree or equivalent in ecology, biology, wildlife ecology, conservation biology, zoology or a related discipline.
Applicants should have experience in quantitative ecological analysis and statistical modelling, proficiency in R or a comparable programming environment, and a strong interest in population and community ecology and ecological responses to environmental change.
The ability to work independently and collaboratively within a research team is essential.
Excellent spoken and written English is required, as the position involves scientific writing, presentations and collaboration in an international research environment.
Additional merits include experience in raptor or avian ecology, analysis of long-term ecological datasets, hierarchical or demographic modelling, spatial ecology, GIS, remote sensing and ecological fieldwork.
We particularly value scientific curiosity, analytical thinking and the ability to formulate independent ecological research questions rather than simply applying existing analytical methods.
About us
The Department of Wildlife, Fish and Environmental Studies at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) in Umeå conducts internationally recognised research in wildlife ecology, conservation biology, restoration ecology and quantitative ecology.
The PhD student will join an active international research environment with opportunities to collaborate with researchers, government agencies and organisations working on the monitoring and conservation of northern raptor populations.
We offer a fully funded four-year PhD position, training in advanced ecological modelling, opportunities for fieldwork and participation in scientific conferences and international research networks.
Learn more about working at SLU: https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/
Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/.

jobs.occupation: PhD Student in Urban Water Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.
The Urban Water Engineering research group at the Department of Civil, Environmental and Natural resources engineering at Luleå University of Technology seeks a driven and committed PhD student to investigate how smart monitoring and predictive modelling can support more effective and environmentally sustainable maintenance of urban drainage infrastructure. The research focuses on understanding sediment accumulation through sensor-based monitoring and data analysis, contributing to improved water quality and urban flood resilience. More information on http://www.ltu.se/water
Subject description
Urban Water Engineering encompasses the entire urban water system (storm drains, drinking water supply and wastewater) with respect to collection, transport and treatment, as well as organisation and planning. The research aims to encourage a strong economy, clean environment and the wise use of resources, while preserving the public’s health and safety.
Project description
Stormwater transports a wide range of pollutants from urban environments to receiving waters, posing major challenges for the protection of surface waters and coastal ecosystems. Urban drainage infrastructures, such as gully pots and stormwater ponds, play a critical role by retaining sediments and associated contaminants. However, their performance depends on effective operation and maintenance (O&M), which in practice is often reactive or based on fixed schedules, despite large spatial and temporal variability in sediment accumulation. This PhD project is part of a larger interdisciplinary research initiative aiming to enable a transition towards more data-driven and environmentally responsible maintenance of urban drainage infrastructures. The overall goal is to reduce pollutant loads to coastal and marine environments while supporting sustainable urban water management.
The PhD research will focus on developing a data-driven understanding of sediment accumulation processes in urban drainage infrastructures. This includes long-term monitoring using high-resolution sensors to capture sediment dynamics across rainfall events and seasons. Based on these data, predictive models will be developed to estimate sediment accumulation and infrastructure’s remaining functionality. The results will support more effective maintenance strategies by identifying when and where maintenances are needed to maximise environmental performance and operational efficiency.
Within this project, the doctoral student will be involved in collaboration with stakeholders in the water and wastewater industry and will communicate results both with the industry and international researchers through LTU's well-established competence network.
Duties
As a PhD student, you will perform both experimental and theoretical work. You will learn how to collect and analyse scientific data within your research area as well as communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. Most of your working time will be devoted to your own research studies, including both research and coursework. In addition, you will also carry out departmental duties, such as teaching and/or assisting in other research projects. You will have two or three supervisors who support you in your work. The research work for this project will specifically include experimental work.
Qualifications
We seek a candidate with an MSc degree or equivalent or fully completed course requirements of at least 240 ETCS of which at least 60 ETCS are at an advanced level or equivalent. The degree should be within the field of water and environment, environmental engineering, natural resources engineering, civil engineering, or equivalent. Specific knowledge of stormwater management, hydraulics/hydrology, statistics, machine learning, thermodynamics (e.g. heat transfer processes) and programming, as well as experience of sensor-based monitoring, are meritorious. Other important skills are the ability to work independently and take initiative, as well as being able to explore new research areas.
English language skills are required since the results will be presented internationally in scientific journals and at conferences. Swedish/Scandinavian language skills are beneficial, as they will facilitate communication with stakeholders and participation in teaching activities. Having a driver’s license is meritorious, as it will facilitate research work.
Applicants should provide contact details to minimum two reference persons upon request.
For further information about a specific subject see:
* http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en

Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added to that time with max 20%. Placement: Luleå. Starting: Spring 2027.

🚀 We’re Hiring: Electrical Engineer – Cable Harness Routing Designer | Automotive
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Electrical Engineer – Cable Harness Routing Designer
Specialisation: Cable Harness Routing | Electrical Installations | CATIA V5 | Vehicle Integration | Automotive Engineering
Location: Södertälje, Sweden
Work Model: 100% On-site
Assignment Period: 1 December 2026 – 30 November 2028
Languages: Swedish and English
About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer – Cable Harness Routing Designer to contribute to the development of advanced electrical installation solutions for next-generation commercial vehicles.
You will be responsible for designing, developing, and releasing cable harness routing solutions that meet electrical, mechanical, manufacturing, quality, serviceability, and cost requirements.
The role covers the complete product development lifecycle, from concept development and detailed CAD design to prototype builds, verification, industrialisation, and engineering changes.
You will collaborate closely with electrical architects, mechanical designers, manufacturing engineers, purchasing teams, and external suppliers to ensure efficient, robust, and production-ready electrical installations.
Key Responsibilities
1. Cable Harness Routing & Electrical Installation
Design and develop cable harness routing solutions using industry-standard CAD tools.

Create and maintain 3D routing models and technical documentation.

Develop electrical installation solutions for vehicle platforms.

Optimise routing based on packaging, robustness, manufacturability, serviceability, quality, and cost.

Ensure compatibility with surrounding mechanical and electrical components.

2. CAD Design & Technical Development
Develop detailed 3D models and technical documentation for electrical installations.

Use CATIA V5 or CATIA 3DEXPERIENCE for routing and installation design.

Perform tolerance analysis and installation feasibility assessments.

Participate in concept development and engineering design reviews.

Ensure compliance with technical requirements and product development standards.

3. Cross-Functional Engineering Collaboration
Work closely with electrical architects, component owners, and mechanical design teams.

Coordinate with manufacturing engineering, purchasing, and external suppliers.

Participate in technical discussions and propose practical engineering solutions.

Ensure alignment between electrical design, mechanical integration, and manufacturing requirements.

Manage multiple activities and maintain effective stakeholder communication.

4. Prototype, Verification & Production Support
Support prototype builds and electrical installation activities.

Participate in verification and validation.

Troubleshoot cable harness routing and installation issues.

Support technical investigations and resolve design-related problems.

Contribute to industrialisation and production engineering.

Manage engineering changes and maintain accurate documentation.

5. Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities to improve routing methods and design practices.

Contribute to engineering standards and technical best practices.

Apply Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles.

Support continuous improvement across electrical installation and vehicle integration.

Required Skills & Experience
Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or an equivalent technical discipline.

Relevant professional experience may also be considered.

Cable Harness Routing & Design
Practical experience in cable harness routing or mechanical installation design.

Job description
Are you passionate about molecular biology, assay development, and shaping the future of precision medicine?
We are currently looking for a hands-on and collaborative R&D Development Engineer for a 6-month consulting assignment at a world-leading, innovative life science company in Uppsala. Join a dynamic R&D team driving groundbreaking protein biomarker discovery!

About the Role
As part of an innovative R&D organization focusing on proteomic sciences, you will play a key role in building and evaluating novel protein biomarker panels for future translational products. This position combines practical, hands-on laboratory work with close cross-functional collaboration, translating scientific concepts into robust, scalable solutions that empower researchers worldwide.

To succeed in this role, you are curious, structured, and a true team player. You enjoy hands-on bench work in a fast-paced R&D environment where open communication and knowledge sharing are valued. You are motivated by contributing to innovative technologies that advance biomedical research and improve human health.
As a consultant at Randstad Life Sciences, you get the opportunity to work at a cutting-edge company in the life science sector while having the security of a collective agreement, competitive salary, pension, insurances, and wellness allowance. You will also have a dedicated Consultant Manager supporting you throughout your assignment. Selection and interviews are conducted continuously, and the position may be filled before the final application date. We look forward to receiving your application in English as soon as possible!

Responsibilities

Plan and execute laboratory experiments according to project plans and timelines.

Evaluate assay and panel performance using established analysis tools and quality criteria.

Analyze, document, and communicate experimental results following standard operating procedures.

Collaborate across multidisciplinary R&D teams to achieve product development milestones.

Participate in technical discussions, troubleshooting activities, and scientific reviews.

Support the transfer of product specifications and knowledge to internal stakeholders.

Contribute to the continuous improvement of laboratory methods, workflows, and development processes.

Qualifications
Required:

M.Sc in Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific discipline.

2–5 years of relevant hands-on laboratory experience in assay development, product development, or laboratory-based research.

Practical experience with molecular biology techniques such as PCR, qPCR, NGS library preparation, and/or immunoassays.

Strong ability to analyze and interpret experimental data and draw scientifically sound conclusions.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).

Proven ability to thrive and collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary teams.

Nice to have:

Experience with multiplex protein detection technologies or molecular diagnostics platforms.

Experience with laboratory automation systems and high-throughput workflows.

Familiarity with LIMS and structured experimental documentation.

Knowledge of product development processes within regulated environments.

About the company

Randstad
På Randstad vet vi att alla människor har en plats på arbetsmarknaden. Med verksamhet över hela landet och inom alla kompetensområden hjälper vi människor att hitta ett jobb som känns bra, och där de får möjlighet att växa, utvecklas och uppnå sin fulla potential. 
Med närmare 600 000 anställda i 38 länder är Randstad världsledande inom HR-tjänster, med målsättningen att bli världens främsta och mest uppskattade partner på arbetsmarknaden. Genom att kombinera vår passion för människor med kraften i dagens teknologi hjälper vi människor och företag att uppnå deras fulla potential. Vi kallar det Human Forward.

Job Description

At IKEA, the product range is our identity. Every textile product we create should be safe, compliant, affordable and designed for the many people. 
As legislation, standards and customer expectations continue to evolve, we need people who are curious about what comes next and motivated by turning complexity into opportunities.
That's why we're looking for a Product Requirement Specialist within Textiles to join us on our journey. 
As a Product Requirement Specialist (PRS), you help IKEA understand and prepare for existing and future product coordinating stakeholders in relevant working groups and forums, e.g. PRIO groups. Be responsible to influence, relevant to the IKEA range, new and existing legislations, regulations, and standards, within assigned area(s) and when relevant, to maintain a network of stakeholders in external alliances, e.g. standardization, organizations and academia. 
You will work closely with colleagues across the value chain while building networks with external stakeholders, including standardization organizations and industry partners. Through these collaborations, you will contribute to influencing legislation, regulations, and standards relevant to the IKEA range. 
If you are energized by understanding what is happening beyond today's requirements and curious about how future developments may shape tomorrow's products, this could be the role for you. 
You are passionate about textiles and motivated by helping others understand complex topics. 
We believe you have: 

University degree in Textile Engineering or Textile Technology 

Knowledge of textile materials and relevant standards, regulations, or product requirements. 

Experience from product development, requirement management, compliance, or another relevant part of the value chain. 

Strong analytical skills and the ability to assess and interpret complex topics. 

The ability to communicate complex issues in a clear and engaging way. 

Experience collaborating with many stakeholders and building strong networks. 

Fluency in English, both written and spoken. 

Most importantly, you are curious, collaborative, and driven by continuous learning. You want to use your expertise to make a difference and contribute to a better everyday life for the many people. 

Additional Information

At IKEA, you'll have the opportunity to combine deep specialist knowledge with collaboration, learning, and influence. You'll join a global environment where your expertise helps us understand change, prepare for the future, and continuously improve the way we develop our products. 
If you're passionate about textiles, fascinated by how requirements shape products, and excited by the opportunity to influence what comes next, we'd love to hear from you. 
This is a permanent position and it´s placed in Älmhult, Sweden.

• What made you interested in this role and enticed you to apply?

jobs.description:
Vi söker just nu en kvalificerad fritidsledare till vårt fritidsteam. Som fritidsledare på IES Sigtuna kommer du att arbeta med att leverera omsorg och stöd före och efter skoltid till våra elever i F-6 och ansvara för att undervisa i enlighet med den nationella fritidsläroplanen. Förutom att utföra ovanstående uppgifter kommer du också att ansvara för att ge specialiserat stöd till eleverna baserat på deras individuella behov. Vi söker personal som, precis som vi, tror på att ge eleverna möjlighet att förverkliga sin fulla potential, oavsett bakgrund. Du måste också vara kunnig och passionerad när det gäller utbildning och barn. Du ska ha verktygen för att skapa en lugn miljö och kunna inspirera eleverna. 

Du ingår i en arbetsgrupp som tillsammans planerar och utvecklar fritidsverksamheten. Du förstår vikten av att samarbeta med dina kollegor, upprätthålla rutiner och regler, se möjligheter, ta stort eget ansvar samt ha ett vänligt och respektfullt bemötande mot alla du möter i arbetet. Vidare måste du ha en god förmåga att skapa positiva relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och personal. Ytterligare egenskaper vi söker är att du kan arbeta strukturerat, men samtidigt vågar vara flexibel. Förmågan att leda i grupp för att motivera och skapa delaktighet är oerhört viktig. Du arbetar bra i team, men kan också ta egna initiativ.

Vi sätter barnet i centrum under hela skoldagen. Vi har en positiv inställning till elevers och kollegors förmågor och vi reflekterar ständigt över hur vi som vuxna tillsammans kan påverka den undervisning vi bedriver i en positiv riktning.

Den här personen bör vara behörig inom något av följande områden:

- Fritidspedagog
- Fritidsledare
- Fritidslärare
- Lärare mot fritidshemmet

IES Sigtuna är en internationell skolmiljö, därför är flytande kunskaper i både engelska och svenska meriterande.

Internationella Engelska Skolan Sigtuna är belägen i ett nybyggt grönområde i Sigtuna kommun och ståtar med den historiska och vackra staden Sigtuna. IES Sigtuna är en skola där varje elev blir sedd och hörd och där du får möjlighet att göra skillnad i deras liv.

Internationella Engelska Skolan är en verkligt internationell skola. Vi har personal och elever från hela världen som bidrar till en dynamisk internationell atmosfär. Våra skolor är tvåspråkiga med upp till 50% av undervisningen på engelska och följer den svenska nationella läroplanen.

Ansök nu och se till att ladda upp ditt CV och ditt personliga brev på vår IES Careers-webbplats.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

jobs.occupation: Teacher Librarian, Bladins International School of Malmö
jobs.description:
At Bladins International School of Malmö (BISM), we are looking for an enthusiastic Teacher Librarian to join our Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) in January 2027.
If you are passionate about inspiring a love of reading, developing information literacy and supporting learning in an international school, we would love to hear from you.
About Bladins International School of Malmö
BISM is an IB Continuum School in central Malmö, offering the Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP) to approximately 360 students from diverse nationalities and cultures.
As part of Bladins Foundation, a non-profit educational organisation, we provide a supportive, internationally minded learning environment where students grow into knowledgeable, caring and responsible global citizens.
The Role
As Teacher Librarian, you will promote reading, inquiry-based learning and students' research, information literacy and critical thinking skills across PYP and MYP.
BISM has two dedicated libraries, one for PYP and one for MYP. You will develop these as welcoming and inclusive learning spaces and work closely with teachers to support learning across the curriculum.
Key responsibilities include:

Developing and managing both school libraries and their print and digital collections

Promoting reading for pleasure through library lessons, initiatives and events

Teaching information literacy, research skills, digital literacy and critical thinking

Collaborating with teachers to support PYP units of inquiry and MYP subjects, with awareness of the curriculum across MYP

Supporting students' Approaches to Learning (ATL) skills, including ethical use of information, referencing and academic integrity

Ensuring resources reflect the school's international, multilingual community and diverse learning needs

Building positive relationships with students, colleagues and families and engaging with the wider BISM community

Contributing to school development and a welcoming library environment

Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a qualified, proactive Teacher Librarian with a passion for literacy and student learning.
You are:

Qualified in library and information science, preferably with school library experience

Experienced in supporting children's and young people's reading, research and information literacy

Knowledgeable about children's and young adult literature and able to inspire readers of different ages

Skilled in inquiry-based learning and collaboration with classroom and subject teachers

Confident using digital library systems, educational technology and online resources

Inclusive, organised and able to manage library activities independently

A positive communicator and collaborative member of an international team

Committed to professional development

Experience with the International Baccalaureate (IB), particularly PYP and/or MYP, is an advantage. Understanding the IB philosophy, Learner Profile and Approaches to Learning (ATL) is highly valued.
As English is the school's working language, professional spoken and written English is required.
Why Join BISM?
At BISM, you will join a welcoming international community committed to students, colleagues and learning. We offer supportive colleagues, professional development, an IB learning environment and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference to students' development.
Employment Information
Position: Teacher Librarian  Employment type: Permanent employment, with a six-month probationary period  Working hours: Part-time (60%)  Start date: January 2027
Application
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. Please apply by 30 November 2026.
For more information, contact:
Kumari Nevill, Primary School Principal Kumari.nevill@bladins.se
We look forward to welcoming a colleague who shares our commitment to high-quality education, collaboration and student success.
